create_sso_config: create an SSOConfig object with Google, Microsoft, or generic OAuth credentials and proxy settings
create_role_mappings: create RoleMappings to map SSO groups from a provider token to LiteLLM user roles
create_default_team_sso_params: create DefaultTeamSSOParams with model access, budget limits, and team member permissions for auto-created teams
create_access_control_ui_access_mode: create AccessControl_UI_AccessMode to restrict UI access to a specific SSO group via JWT field
create_team_mappings: create TeamMappings to extract team IDs from an SSO JWT token field for automatic team assignment
